(rule!
 (let ((dummy 0))
   (define (colors-reading grid)
     (remove-duplicates
      (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0)))
              (map (lambda (p) (at grid (first p) (second p)))
                   (grid-positions grid)))))
   (define (record-of grid color)
     (let* ((cells (find-color grid color))
            (a (first cells))
            (b (second cells))
            (rlo (min (first a) (first b)))
            (rhi (max (first a) (first b)))
            (clo (min (second a) (second b)))
            (chi (max (second a) (second b))))
       (list color (list rlo clo rhi chi))))
   (define (record-area record)
     (let ((box (second record)))
       (* (+ 1 (- (third box) (first box)))
          (+ 1 (- (fourth box) (second box))))))
   (define (cells-for box filled?)
     (let* ((r1 (first box))
            (c1 (second box))
            (r2 (third box))
            (c2 (fourth box))
            (cells (positions-in-rect r1 c1 r2 c2)))
       (if filled?
           cells
           (filter (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) r1) (= (first p) r2)
                         (= (second p) c1) (= (second p) c2)))
                   cells))))
   (define records (map (lambda (color) (record-of g color))
                        (colors-reading g)))
   (define selected-index
     (modulo (- (record-area (first records)) 1) (length records)))
   (let loop ((xs records)
              (index 0)
              (out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)))
     (if (empty? xs)
         out
         (let* ((record (first xs))
                (color (first record))
                (box (second record))
                (next (paint-cells out (cells-for box (= index selected-index)) color)))
           (loop (rest xs) (+ index 1) next))))))
